title: Receivables Guide — Payments, Credit Memos and Service Level Credits on Paystride Program Invoices
content:
Under the Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement, payments and credits settle program invoice lines and late charges as follows.

**Payments.** Each employer payment is applied to the invoice line or late charge it names, up to that line's unpaid amount; an unallocated payment is applied to the oldest unpaid line first, and payments never settle remittances.

**Credit memos.** A credit memo points to the line it credits and never exceeds what is unpaid on it. A billed line receives at most one credit memo of each reason.

**Service level credit (no longer in force).** The clause "When a month's measured availability on the census is below the tier's availability commitment, the employer is given a service level credit, with reason SLA credit and pointing to that month's platform fee line, of the percentage of the service level credit ladder for the lowest availability band reached, computed on the platform fee after any bundle discount." is no longer in force; it is superseded by the current basis.

**Claim window.** An SLA credit is granted only when the employer claims it within the tier's claim window, in calendar days, after the end of the affected month. Calendar days are counted from the first day of the month after the affected month, so a claim on the last day of the window, the affected month's last day plus the window, is in time. The affected month is the census month whose measured availability is in question.

**Go-live delay credit.** When go-live came later than the tier's go-live target, in business days after the signed date, for reasons on Paystride's side, the implementation fee line is credited the tier's go-live delay credit percentage of that fee; a delay caused by the employer's late payroll file earns nothing.

**Billing error (no longer in force).** The clause "A line billed in error is credited in full with reason billing error." is no longer in force; it is superseded by the current basis.

**Courtesy waiver.** A courtesy late charge waiver credits the whole late charge under the late charge terms. These other credits are credit memos.

## Claim window illustrated (hypothetical, 30-day window)

| Affected month ends on | Window counted from | Last day in time | A claim one day later |
|---|---|---|---|
| the 30th | the 1st of the next month | 30 calendar days after the month's last day | not in time |
| the 31st | the 1st of the next month | 30 calendar days after the month's last day | not in time |

## Go-live delay credit illustrated (hypothetical)

On an Enterprise Plus program with an implementation fee of 15000.00 and a go-live delay credit of 15 percent, a go-live later than the target for reasons on Paystride's side earns a credit memo of 2250.00 on the implementation fee line; the same delay caused by the employer's late payroll file earns nothing.

superseded_clauses: When a month's measured availability_percent on the census is below sla_uptime_target_percent, the employer is given a service level credit, with reason sla_credit and pointing to that month's platform_fee line, of the percentage of sla_credit_ladder_percent for the lowest availability band reached, computed on the platform fee after any bundle discount.
A line billed in error is credited in full with reason billing_error.
